Mira S.: Hi team, I turned in my notice this morning. Last day 2025-01-10. I'm in EU and have ongoing parental leave questions
nd equity cliff vest 2025-01-15. Also I have a company phone and a leased laptop. Can we confirm returns and whether parental leave affects RSU cliff?
Priya (People Ops): Thanks for the update, Mira. We'll open an offboard ticket and outline local parental leave policy interactions with equity. Quick: COBRA notice will go out (if you're on US plan), final pay will process on next payroll, and IT will coordinate device returns. For the equity cliff, comp-admin will confirm but usually cliff vest requires active employment through the date. We'll loop comp-admin.
Marta (HR): Adding policy note: for parental leave we have return-to-work protections, but equity vesting follows grant terms. If your leave overlaps termination, that may be treated as involuntary in limited cases; comp-admin to confirm. Expect an email within 2 business days.
Jae - IT: Mira or devices: we'll provide a local carrier label for the phone and leased laptop. Please don't factory reset, remove personal data if you wish. We'll revoke mobile device management after we receive the phone. When do you prefer SSO disable?
Mira S.: Disable SSO EOD on last day, and revoke tokens next morning so I can do the last handovers. Also I have shared drive docs that the team needs read access to for 2 weeksan that be done?
Leah (Manager): I'll take over ownership of the shared drive and ensure the team has read access. Also scheduling a 2-hour KT session on 2025-01-08 to transfer outstanding tasks.
Oliver (Payroll): Final pay includes pro-rated salary and payout of accrued leave per local laws and any expense reimbursements pending. Deductions for benefits stop on last paycheck. If you have leave payout questions DM me employee ID and country.
security-bot: Offboard ticket #OB-2025-001 created. Scheduled actions: SSO disable 2025-01-10T18:00:00Z, GitHub token revocation 2025-01-11T07:00:00Z, Mobile device revocation 2025-01-10T18:15:00Z.
Mira S.: Cool. One oddball: I set up a third-party subscription using the company card for a project (billing on file). Who should I transfer that to before I leave?
Priya (People Ops): Add the service and ownership transfer to the offboard ticket and tag IT/billing. We'll need the vendor, login, and billing contact. Priya (People Ops) will own but tag Finance if it's billed to company card.
Marta (HR): Comp-admin has confirmed via DM: cliff vest on 2025-01-15 will not vest if termination is effective 2025-01-10. We'll send the formal comp email.
Mira S.: Thanks for confirming. I'll adjust expectations and ensure handoffs. Also, can my mailbox be auto-forwarded to Leah for 45 days?
Priya (People Ops): Yes, forwarding to Leah for 45 days set. Also sending exit questionnaire and scheduler for a 30-min exit interview.
Mira S.: Booked exit interview for 2025-01-13 10:00 CET. Thanks everyone.
